meta.description: The app every gamer needs: your games and your controllers, on one PC.
hero.title: The app every gamer needs.
hero.lead: Your games and your controllers, in one place.
hero.fine: Windows 10 1809 or newer, 64-bit. Free during early access.
shot.library: The Lobby library: every game from every launcher, in one grid.
shot.pads: The controller tester: sticks, triggers and sensors, live.
strip.title: Reads the launchers you already use
modules.title: Two modules, ready today
modules.rest: More modules are coming. They appear here when they are ready.
library.title: One library, not ten
library.short: Every launcher in a single list. Search, sort, launch.
library.lead: Every launcher in one list, with cover art, play time and install date. Search, sort, launch.
library.point.two: Grid, banner or list, your choice
library.point.three: Favourites, filters and four sort orders
pads.title: Controllers that simply work
pads.short: Remap in one click, with a live tester on the same page.
pads.lead: A DualSense or a Switch 2 Pro becomes a controller every game understands, in one click. Battery, lightbar and a full tester on the same page.
pads.point.one: Remap in one click, no driver to hunt down
pads.point.two: Live tester: sticks, triggers, sensors, touchpad
pads.point.three: Profiles: your buttons, where you want them
download.title: One file to install everything
download.pc.text: One installer. The Manager it lays down lets you pick your modules.
download.android.text: A real app, served straight from this site.
download.android.fine: Android asks permission to install a downloaded file: open it, then allow this source.
download.iphone.text: Open your PC address in Safari, then Add to Home Screen.
download.iphone.fine: Apple does not allow installing a downloaded file.
activate.title: No key needed
activate.lead: Every module opens without a key, without an account, and with nothing to paste.
activate.later: When early access ends, paid modules will ask for a key. It answers one machine, and this site never stores it.
privacy.title: Nothing leaves your PC
privacy.telemetry.text: Nothing is measured, nothing is sent.
privacy.offline.text: Activation is verified on your PC. This site could be shut down tomorrow without a single install stopping.
privacy.account.text: No email, no password, no list of machines.
versions.title: One channel, the same for everyone
versions.lead: Every module Lobby publishes, and the ones still being built.
versions.next.lead: Announced. Each one appears above the day it is published.
versions.unreachable: The release journal is unreachable for the moment.
